about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a medieval merchant and create the shop of your dreams. In Medieval Shop Simulator, you’ll buy, sell, and craft goods to satisfy the endless stream of peasants, nobles, and rogues wandering through your door. Whether it’s sharpening swords, polishing armor, or dealing with thieves, every day brings new challenges.

Manage your stock and expand through trade routes that unlock new items and opportunities. From humble beginnings to becoming the most renowned shopkeeper in the kingdom, your choices shape your path.

But beware – medieval life isn’t easy. Festivals, taxes, thieves, and even diseased customers will test your skills. Will you rise to the challenge and build a thriving empire, or watch your shop crumble into dust?

Key Features

  • 🛡️ Run your own medieval store – stock shelves, set prices, and manage customers.

  • ⚒️ Unique minigames – sharpen weapons, repair armor, clean items, and more.

  • 👑 Dynamic customers – from poor peasants to wealthy lords, each with their own needs and quirks.

  • 📈 Progression & trade routes – expand your shop and unlock rare items through distant merchants.

  • 🎉 Special events – festivals, royal visits, and surprises that change the flow of business.

Forge your fortune, outsmart your rivals, and prove yourself as the greatest merchant of the Middle Ages!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Run and expand your own medieval shop! Sell weapons, armor, food, and rare goods to peasants and lords alike in the immersive medieval store simulator.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
